header.corpus: sappelli_enron (Sappelli et al. 2016; Schulz-dump join) — recipient reply behaviour

matchKinds.quoted: a referenceinfo row for the replying mid reproduces the probe's body prefix (64 alphanumeric chars). This dump's referenceinfo holds QUOTED ORIGINAL TEXT, not In-Reply-To/References header ids — 5 of 54,778 rows mention JavaMail at all — so the header chain the strict leg was specified against does not exist here.
matchKinds.subject: the replying message's subject normalises equal to the probe's (repeated re:/fw:/fwd: stripped) and its sender is one of the probe's TO/CC recipients

thresholds.note: buckets: fast <= 24h, slow 24h..30d, none = observable with no reply, unobservable = no custodian recipient and nothing seen

header.observability: the Enron corpus is the mail of ~150 custodians; a reply by a non-custodian recipient was never captured, so its absence is not evidence. A row is observable when a reply WAS seen or at least one recipient is on the dump's employeelist roster.
